<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def door_state(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O': out['O']=n['boundary']
        if n['color']=='b' and n['boundary'][0][0]>40: out['b']=n['boundary']
    return out
print("start:", door_state(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("after RIGHT:", door_state(current_frame))
for i in range(5):
    action(['UP'])
    d = door_state(current_frame)
    print("UP",i+1,":", d, "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
